subject.title: chore(env): config-surface reduction tranche 4 — env-var cleanup (review request)

question: Should OpenClaw formally retire the undocumented OPENCLAW_* aliases and internal controls changed by this PR, using the new documentation allowlist as the supported operator contract?
rationale: The branch deliberately turns undocumented environment behavior into a non-contract across numerous independently deployed launch paths; source review can verify mechanics but cannot choose the compatibility promise maintainers want to make.

options.title: Approve the documented cutoff
options.body: Keep only the documented operator-facing variables after real runtime and upgrade-path evidence covers the removed aliases, ACPX launch path, and CI ratchet.

options.title: Retain selected compatibility aliases
options.body: Identify specific existing service or integration variables that remain supported, then restore them with a bounded deprecation and migration plan.

options.title: Split uncertain retirements
options.body: Land the test-runtime isolation and ratchet separately while deferring aliases whose external deployment use is not yet audited.

recommendation.title: Approve the documented cutoff
recommendation.body: Keep only the documented operator-facing variables after real runtime and upgrade-path evidence covers the removed aliases, ACPX launch path, and CI ratchet.

likelyOwner.reason: The current author also carried the immediately preceding merged config-surface tranches and has the strongest visible history for the intended contract boundary.
